correctness.rationale: The eight-bit cross-adjacency predicate is directly defined on five-bit cube vertices. Greedy class coloring yields a valid clique upper bound in the finite exhaustive search. After fixing an anchor by edge transitivity, the verified search rules out 12 mutually compatible other edges in 51 candidates. The explicit 80-color vector has 7 colors, all 1120 conflicting pairs different, sizes 11x4 and 12x3. Both pure-Python and separate C++ checks passed.

value.rationale: The injective edge index is a fundamental graph channel-assignment invariant, not a renaming of the packing number. A seven-way partition of the Q5 edge set is an exact previously unprovided finite benchmark for a canonical Cartesian graph and is near-equitable, hence a nontrivial packing-design fact rather than just an improved numerical bound.
